title: The First Promise
summary: In the garden, on the worst day, God makes the first promise: the serpent-crusher will come.

title: The Sign of Immanuel
summary: The virgin will conceive and bear a son, and call him Immanuel — God with us.

title: A Child Is Born
summary: The people walking in darkness see a great light: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Prince of Peace.

title: The Branch from Jesse
summary: From the stump of Jesse's family tree, a Branch will grow — and the wolf will lie down with the lamb.

title: Little Bethlehem
summary: Seven hundred years early, the prophet names the town: out of tiny Bethlehem comes the Ruler.

title: The Star and the Scepter
summary: Even a reluctant prophet sees it far off: a star will come out of Jacob.

title: The Righteous Branch
summary: In dark days, God repeats the promise: a righteous Branch from David's line.

title: Comfort, Comfort
summary: Prepare the way for the Lord — every valley raised, and the glory of the Lord revealed.

title: The Messenger
summary: The last prophet's word before four hundred years of silence: the messenger is coming.

title: The Desert Blooms
summary: When He comes, blind eyes open, deaf ears hear, and the desert bursts into flower.

title: An Angel in the Temple
summary: The silence breaks: Gabriel tells old Zechariah his son will prepare the Lord's way.

title: The Annunciation
summary: Gabriel comes to Mary in Nazareth: 'You will conceive and give birth to a son... the Son of God.'

title: Mary Visits Elizabeth
summary: John leaps in the womb, and Elizabeth cries: 'Blessed is she who has believed!'

title: Mary's Song
summary: The Magnificat: 'My soul glorifies the Lord... He has lifted up the humble.'

title: John Is Born
summary: The forerunner arrives, and everyone asks: 'What then is this child going to be?'

title: Zechariah's Song
summary: His tongue set free, Zechariah sings of the rising sun coming to us from heaven.

title: The Family Tree
summary: Abraham to David to the exile to Joseph — the whole crooked, graced line that leads to Jesus.

title: Joseph's Dream
summary: An angel tells Joseph: 'Name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.'

title: The Road to Bethlehem
summary: A census moves an empire so one young family arrives in the town the prophet named.

title: No Room
summary: The King of kings is born and laid in a manger, because there was no guest room.

title: Angels over the Fields
summary: Glory blazes over a night shift: 'I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people.'

title: The Shepherds Run
summary: The shepherds hurry, find the baby, and leave glorifying God — the first to spread the word.

title: The Magi and the Star
summary: Wise men follow the star, bow low, and open their treasures: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

title: Simeon's Arms
summary: Old Simeon holds the baby and sings: 'My eyes have seen your salvation.'

title: The Word Made Flesh
summary: Christmas Day: the Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us — full of grace and truth.
